# DEVCON Philippines

> DEVCON Philippines (DevConnect Philippines Inc.) is the Philippines' largest volunteer tech community: an SEC-registered, BIR-compliant non-profit founded in 2009, with 13 locations across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao. Theme for 2026 (DEVCON 17): Engineering an AI-Ready Nation.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2009. Legal name: DevConnect Philippines Inc. Status: non-profit (SEC-registered, BIR-compliant).
- Reach: 70k+ online; 19k+ face-to-face attendees in 2025; 120+ free events every year; 500+ builders trained on AI Fluency.
- Locations (13): Manila, Laguna, Legazpi, Pampanga (Luzon); Cebu, Iloilo, Bohol, Bacolod, Tacloban (Visayas); Davao, Cagayan de Oro, Iligan, Bukidnon (Mindanao). Bohol, Bacolod, Tacloban, and Cagayan de Oro are volunteer communities.
- DEVCON HQ Office: Makati or Ortigas, Metro Manila. Contact: hello@devcon.ph.
- AI programs: Hour of AI for Kids, Open-Source AI Code Camps, AI Fluency Masterclass for Builders with an Agentic AI Hackathon, 5-month AI Engineering Internships, AI Certification Scholarships.
